title: Mannequin Egg Rework
description: Retextures Mannaquin Spawn Egg so it matches vanilla eggs
body:
Retextures the Mannequin Spawn Egg from the [Mannequin](https://modrinth.com/mod/mannequin-mod) mod so it matches the vanilla eggs
![Icon of resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9G2LL5w3/images/be8ff514b78134760d452a4484b6b948d1b7f31c.png)

This pack has zero relation to the mod or its creators, I made this because I really didn't like the texture used!
